title: Clack theme, format 1
description: How a Clack slideshow looks. Every value is a typed token that Clack validates and compiles into CSS custom properties; nothing in a theme is CSS, so a theme can change how Clack looks and nothing else. Every property but format and name is optional: a theme starts from the one it extends (base unless it says otherwise) and overrides what it sets. Documented in docs/themes.md.

format.description: The format and its version. A file in a format this Clack does not know is refused, never guessed at.

name.description: Shown wherever a theme is chosen.

extends.description: The built-in theme this one starts from (default: base). Only built-in themes can be extended, so loading a theme never fetches another.

scheme.description: auto follows the visitor's light or dark setting, live; light or dark forces that scheme, and then only its colours are used.

colors.description: The colours of each scheme, by role. Colours behind photographs should be neutral: a tinted surround shifts how every photo looks.

position.description: Where auto-play's progress line sits: below the caption, or along the bottom edge of the show.

details.description: The metadata panel, when the page has asked for metadata to be shown.

position.description: Beside the photo, under it, or over it. On a narrow show every position becomes a sheet over the lower part of the photo.

fonts.description: Which typeface each family uses. Only the visitor's system fonts for now; bundled, open-licensed fonts will add values here. A theme can never name a font to fetch.

^x-.description: Extensions: ignored by Clack, kept for whoever wrote them.

color.description: A hex colour (#rgb, #rgba, #rrggbb, #rrggbbaa) or rgb(r g b) / rgb(r g b / alpha), with r, g and b from 0 to 255 and alpha from 0 to 1 or a percentage.

palette.description: Colours by role. A theme sets the roles it changes; the rest come from the theme it extends.

canvas.description: Behind everything: the wall the photos hang on.

surface.description: Panels over the canvas, such as the details panel.

text.description: Captions and titles. Must reach 4.5:1 against canvas and surface.

muted.description: Secondary text: credits, counters, labels. Must reach 4.5:1 against canvas and surface.

hairline.description: Rules, dividers, the progress track, a hovered control's backdrop.

accent.description: The keyboard focus ring and the active state. Must reach 3:1 against canvas.

control.description: Control icons at rest. Must reach 3:1 against canvas.

controlActive.description: Control icons when hovered or pressed.

mat.description: The mat board around each photo (matted layout).

frame.description: The picture frame around the mat (matted layout).

label.description: The caption card, when caption.card is on.

labelText.description: Text on the caption card. Must reach 4.5:1 against label.

labelMuted.description: Secondary text on the caption card. Must reach 4.5:1 against label.

edgePrint.description: Frame numbers printed on the film's edge. Must reach 4.5:1 against film.

mark.description: The grease-pencil mark on a picked frame (contact-sheet index).

length.description: A length that is not negative: 0, or a number with a unit. em is of the show's text; cqi and cqw are of the show's width; vw, vh, vmin and vmax of the window.

fluidLength.description: A length, or one that grows with the show between a minimum and a maximum (CSS clamp()).

fontSize.description: A font size: from 8px to 48px, or from 0.5 to 3 in rem or em.

tracking.description: Letter spacing in em, from -0.05em to 0.3em.

duration.description: A duration in ms or s, at most 3 seconds.

family.description: A font family, set to a typeface in fonts.

text.description: How a line of text is set.

layout.description: How the photo sits in the show.

type.description: gallery: generous margins, caption beneath, like a museum wall. stage: dark surround, the photo the only light. matted: each photo in a mat board and frame. full-bleed: the photo as large as the show, controls floating over it. Layouts are Clack's code; a theme chooses and tunes one.

padding.description: Space between the show's edge and its contents.

shadow.description: A shadow under the photo, lifting it off the canvas. soft is tuned for each scheme.

mat.description: The mat board (matted layout). Its colour is the mat colour.

bevel.description: A fine bevelled edge where the mat is cut, catching the light.

frame.description: The picture frame around the mat (matted layout). Its colour is the frame colour.

caption.description: The photo's title and caption, beneath it or in the controls.

card.description: Set the caption on a printed card, in the label colours, like a museum label.

credit.description: Show the credit line under the caption.

header.description: The line above the photo, with the show's title and how many photos it has; shown only when the show has a title.

style.description: plain: icons on the canvas. floating: a translucent bar over the photo, for full-bleed.

size.description: Each control's target size. Clack never makes a target smaller than 24px (WCAG 2.5.8).

reveal.description: always: controls are always visible. on-activity: they fade in when the pointer moves or focus arrives, and out again after a few seconds. The pause control is always reachable by keyboard either way.

type.description: How one photo gives way to the next. With reduced motion, slide becomes a short crossfade.

index.description: How <clack-index>, the index of a show's photos, looks, so one theme styles the index and the slideshow alike.

style.description: justified: rows of equal height, each photo in its own proportions, filling the width. contact-sheet: strips of film with frame numbers.

rowHeight.description: The height of a justified row.

frameWidth.description: The smallest width of a frame on a contact sheet; as many fit in a strip as will.
